extracted.name: Mimi's M&M Cookies
extracted.description: Great recipe for Mimi's M&M Cookies.
ingredient_lines: 40 g M&M or however you like it
instruction_lines: Beat "soft unsalted butter" and "brown sugar" and "salt"
Add "all-purpose flour" and "baking soda" and continue beating it until smooth
Add "chocolate chips" and if you are lazy add "M&M" too or put them neatly however you like later before baking
Lay the dough nice on the baking tray however big or small or whichever shape you like
